subject: Alignment: L6 Manager vs Principal IC — Samir Gupta offer
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Alignment: L6 Manager vs Principal IC — Samir Gupta offer

Team —

Quick context: Samir (resume attached) finished loops for the infra/serving leader role. Hiring manager is recommending L6 Engineering Manager; hiring panel flagged that his background is borderline Principal IC in embedded infra leadership, and there's a salary/leveling wrinkle with his current comp. We need to lock title and comp before we extend an offer.

Asks:
- Can we confirm L6 Manager vs Principal IC (implications for org/people mgmt and band anchor)?
- If L6 Manager, what should be the base + comp band anchor, sign-on lever, and equity target (midpoint or above)?
- Any headcount approvals still required from Finance/People Ops to commit?

Candidate essentials:
- Name: Samir Gupta
- Role: Infrastructure — Serving Runtime (manager track)
- Req: HC-2027-014 (see Jira link)
- Hiring manager: Marcus Lin (copied in Greenhouse)

My read: hiring manager wants manager slot; compensation request is ~15% above our L6 midpoint because Samir is leaving a manager+tech lead package. If we do Principal IC, we'd need to move money within the band and it affects team headcount (we'd be making a technical IC hire rather than a people manager).

Attachments: Samir_Gupta_resume.pdf, comp_matrix_Q1_2027.xlsx

I propose we align on L6 Manager with a one-time sign-on to bridge the delta and mark the offer "Manager (L6)" in the offer letter, with the option to revisit title after 12 months based on scope. If you prefer Principal IC, please state the justification so I can route to the compensation committee.

Thanks — please reply with green/red and suggested numbers so I can get this into a draft offer by EOD Wed.

—
Karthik Iyer
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alignment: L6 Manager vs Principal IC — Samir Gupta offer

Karthik —

Thanks for the summary. High-level reaction: I support L6 Manager for this hire given Marcus's org needs (direct reports plus cross-team ownership). Reasoning: Samir's prior scope included managing 3 ICs + owning infra rollout, which maps to our manager expectations. Principal IC would be a bigger lift for org design and is not strictly required.

Comp suggestion (L6 Manager):
- Base: $205,000 — this places him ~7% above L6 midpoint to reflect retention risk
- Equity: 0.25% RSU over 4 years (accelerated 1st year vesting for retention)
- Sign-on: $40,000 one-time (payable over first payroll cycle)
- Target OTE: structure as base + RSU; no comp change without panel review

Headcount / approvals:
- Finance approval required for sign-on > $30k. Please route HC-2027-014 to Finance (cc: finance-approvals@redwoodinference.com) with the comp summary.
- People Ops to confirm leveling matrix application (Neha, can you confirm final anchor and whether we mark as L6 Manager or L6 (manager-track) in Greenhouse?)

If Neha recommends Principal IC based on benchmarking, we'll do a quick comp-committee fast-track.

—
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering (hiring partner)
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Alignment: L6 Manager vs Principal IC — Samir Gupta offer

Laura / Karthik —

Quick benchmark notes (attached comp_matrix_Q1_2027.xlsx): CompBench shows median for L6 Manager in SF market: base $190–215k, equity 0.18–0.32%. Samir's ask (reasonably) sits toward the high end because of manager + infra domain expertise.

Options I recommend:
1) L6 Manager (preferred based on team org): Base $205k + 0.25% RSU + $40k sign-on (Finance approval required). This aligns to Laura's recommendation.
2) Principal IC: If leadership insists, label as Principal IC (L6 equivalent), set base $210k + 0.30% RSU but require comp-committee signoff for title exception. This route has internal ripple effects on adjacent IC leveling.

I attached a completed HC approval form (HC_approval_form_SG.docx) with finance checkbox left open for sign-on approval. Please note: if we show an explicit "title re-eval in 12 months" in the offer letter, it reduces escalation risk for later promotion conversations.

—
Neha Kapoor
Head of Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: L6 Manager offer elements for Samir Gupta — next steps

Thanks all — good alignment. Summary and next steps: 

Decision: L6 Engineering Manager (title: Engineering Manager, L6).
Comp package to proceed with (subject to Finance sign-off on sign-on):
- Base: $205,000
- Equity: 0.25% RSU (4y)
- Sign-on: $40,000 one-time (Finance approval required)

Action items:
- Karthik: draft offer letter and route to Legal for standard language; include a clause "title will be reviewed after 12 months for scope and impact". Assemble offer summary doc (Samir_Gupta_offer_summary.pdf) and send to Marcus for candidate discussion.
- Laura: confirm manager org start-date expectations with Marcus.
- Neha: please run Finance approval for sign-on (Finance approvers: finance-approvals@redwoodinference.com) and confirm approach to accelerated vesting.
- Tessa: open HC ticket HC-2027-014 in Jira (link included) and update Greenhouse with L6 Manager anchor once Finance confirms.

I'll hold off on sending the candidate the formal offer until Finance confirms sign-on. If Finance pushes back, we will reduce sign-on to $30k and move $10k into equity refresh within year 1.

Attachments: Samir_Gupta_offer_summary.pdf (draft)

Thanks again for the quick turnaround. If no objections by EOD Thu I'll proceed to Legal + Finance routing.

—
Karthik Iyer
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
